description.value:
You generate a sustained dark energy aura that continuously destabilizes everything around you.

You project a @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15-foot warp aura} for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, all enemies within the aura take 1d4 void damage and must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)|options:me-power:me-adept-warp-field] save against your class DC or become Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. Dismiss as a free action.

When a creature rolls the save above, the result for its degree of success is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting). Damage is rolled once and shared by every creature in the area.

Prerequisite: Warp Upgrade. Classes: Adept.
